name: Search API Exclude Paragraphs
description: A Search API processor that removes selected Paragraph types from rendered-content indexing so they are not searchable.
project_description:
This module makes it possible to exclude certain types of Paragraphs from being indexed in search indexes using Search API framework.

 Features 
 When using a Paragraphs-based layout model for content, it is oftentimes desirable to use the Rendered HTML to index content rather than or in addition to specifying fields within Paragraph types. In many cases, though, content within Paragraph types is not relevant to the current node—for example, Paragraphs containing output from Views, promotional links to other nodes or external sites, or repetitive features that need not be indexed.

 Requirements 
 
 Search API 
 Paragraphs 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Add your search server and an index in Search API. 
 Enable the "Exclude Paragraphs" processor. 
 In the processor settings select the Paragraph types that should be excluded from the active index.
